subject: Reserve swing panel provisioning & skill-match request — Backend Engineer loop
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel <daniel@talentpartners.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@waverly.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Reserve swing panel provisioning & skill-match request — Backend Engineer loop

Team —

We have a heavy interview cadence for the BE IC role next week (12 interviews across Mon/Wed/Thu). Hiring has asked for a small reserve/swing panel to handle overflow and last-minute backfills so we don’t double-book PM/infra leads. Need volunteers + explicit skill matches.

Goal: assemble 4 reserve interviewers who can be scheduled on <24h notice>, with these skill tags prioritized: microservices, distributed systems, DB tuning, and debugging at scale. Ideally 2 seniors (L5+) and 2 mid-level (L3–L4). Timezone coverage: PDT mornings and EDT afternoons preferred.

Can each of you reply with: 1) names you recommend from your teams, 2) any absolute blackout dates next week, and 3) whether they’re willing to do a follow-up debrief if they end up as reserves? I’ve attached a current roster snapshot (swing_panel_roster_v1.csv) and a skill tag cheat sheet.

I’ll consolidate and push calendar invites once we confirm.

Thanks —
Naomi
Sr. Recruiting Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: swing_panel_roster_v1.csv (csv stub), skill-tags-reference.pdf (pdf stub)

---
On Thu, 2 Aug 2028 at 10:08, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick list below of volunteers I can mobilize this week (all internal):
- Rohan Mehta (L5) — microservices, scaling; available all week except Tue morning
- Maya Srinivasan (L4) — DB tuning, query perf; open Mon/Wed afternoons
- Ethan Park (L4) — debugging/incident RCA; flexible Thurs/Friday
- Priya Natarajan (L3) — systems fundamentals; can do early PDT windows

Two notes: Rohan prefers not to do initial screens back-to-back more than twice a day; Priya needs calendar invites at least 6 hours ahead due to deep focus blocks. I added them to the sheet and flagged timezones.

Monica
Talent Partner — Recruiting Operations

---
On Fri, 3 Aug 2028 at 14:31, Daniel <daniel@talentpartners.com> wrote:

Naomi / team —

Candidate feedback loop: Waverly's hiring manager (Emily) asked that any reserve interviewer be available to join a 30-min debrief within 45 minutes of a loop finishing if they conducted any portion of that loop. That’s a strict request for the hiring committee this round. Candidate constraints: two candidates are only available 11:30–14:30 PDT on Mon and Wed; one candidate has a hard block on Thu after 15:00 PDT.

I’ve shared the Greenhouse slots (link above) and will mark candidate windows. Let me know if the 45-min debrief SLA is workable — we can push for 60 mins only if someone flags it as impossible.

Thanks,
Daniel
Senior Recruiter, TalentPartners (vendor)

---
On Sat, 4 Aug 2028 at 09:02, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:

Short update — I can commit the following from infra and platform (and confirm debrief availability):
- Marcus Lin (L5) — DB tuning, distributed traces; yes to debriefs
- Diego Fernandez (L4) — microservices + caching; yes but prefers afternoon PDT

I’ll cover a rotation if Marcus is scheduled multiple times. I’ll also add buffer slots for Marcus on Wed in the sheet.

Karthik
Eng Manager, Platform

---
On Wed, 9 Aug 2028 at 16:42, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:

Thanks everyone — consolidated plan below and next steps.
1) Reserve panel confirmed (2 seniors, 2 mids): Rohan Mehta (L5), Marcus Lin (L5), Maya Srinivasan (L4), Priya Natarajan (L3).
2) Availability/constraints applied to scheduler; Daniel, I flagged the candidate windows and set the debrief window to 45 min per Emily’s ask. If an interviewer can’t meet the 45-min SLA we’ll mark them as non-debrief resources and have a fallback (Karthik / Marcus).
3) Calendar: I created tentative blocks and will send confirmed invites as candidates time into slots.
4) Ops notes: please avoid scheduling more than two back-to-back loops per interviewer. Monica — please confirm that Priya is comfortable with invites 6+ hours ahead; if yes I’ll mark her as high-priority for early-PDT slots.

Attachments: updated roster (swing_panel_roster_v1.csv) — final; skill-tags-reference.pdf.

If there are any changes after 5pm PDT today, reply-all and I’ll re-run the slot allocation.

Naomi
Sr. Recruiting Ops | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
